[[File:Kotor2_plasma_torch.png|thumb|250px|A plasma torch.]]
'''Plasma torches''' were tools used to cut through solid objects with a flow of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]], they could be used as weapons. They are known to have been used in the [[Peragus Mining Facility]]; when [[Meetra Surik]] was trapped inside the facility's medical bay, she used a plasma torch to cut the way out through a closed door.

Plasma torches were also used by [[Tien Tubb]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

[[GRZ-6B wrecker droid]]s had an industrial-grade plasma torch built into its left palm.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Plasma torches are notable in the game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' for being one of the most useful tools in the game, being able to bash almost any locked door or container open.
